{"notes": "VISIT 2 (left 3:30). Table: both body arcs now run from START and are fully connected. The pale gap at the upper arc's end (~10.5, 5.5) is fixed, but I don't know who fixed it. The upper tail runs along y≈5-7 and ends at about (26.5, 5.2). The lower chain runs to the tail tip (~28.3, 13) and back to about (25, 10). A gap of roughly 5 units remains between the two tail ends (the notch), so the fish outline isn't closed yet.

Jack: His claim 'lower tail done, soft tip' matches the table, since the lower chain is connected and smooth to the notch. He is checking the joins around the fork and asked Omar for status, which is good coordination. I still can't confirm he placed those dominoes, so credit is provisional but positive.

Omar: At 3:15 he said the upper tail was 'about halfway round the tip'. The upper chain ends near (26.5, 5.2), well short of the tip, so his progress report looks optimistic. The upper tail also hasn't started curving down toward the notch. That may be a status-reporting issue, not a build problem. On the next visit, check whether the upper tail closes the gap and whether he reports honestly. I won't penalise him yet.

Hana: Not seen or heard this visit, so no new evidence. Her earlier leadership was strong. Check that the body strokes are done and whether she's helping close the tail.

Sofia: Again nothing seen or heard. I still can't assess her. Ask her privately what she built and what she fixed."}
